title: Con las manos vacías
desc: A year of doing something wrong, and the day somebody finally says so
setting: You are on your way out to Marcos's house and doña Carmen has stopped you at the gate.

steps.speaker: Doña Carmen
steps.en: And you are going like that? Without taking anything?

options.en: How do you mean, doña? What should I take?
options.feedback: She has finally said it. Ask, because you are about to learn something you have been getting wrong since the day you arrived.
It makes no difference whose house it is. She is not going to let you out of the gate on that.

options.es: En mi país no se lleva nada.
options.en: Where I am from you do not take anything.
options.feedback: She knows. That is exactly why she has waited a year to mention it, and defending the habit wastes the moment.

steps.speaker: Doña Carmen
steps.es: Algo, mijo. Aunque sea una gaseosa. Aunque sea pan.
steps.en: Something, love. Even a fizzy drink. Even bread.

options.es: Ya. Entonces paso por la pulpería primero.
options.en: Right. Then I will stop at the pulpería first.
options.feedback: Fix it immediately and out loud. A bag of bread from the pulpería on the corner does the whole job.

options.en: Next time I will take something.
options.feedback: Next time is not today, and today you are already at the gate with your hands empty.

options.es: Marcos no va a decir nada.
options.feedback: Nobody ever says anything. That is precisely how you have managed to do it for a year.

options.es: ¿Y por qué no me lo había dicho antes, doña?
options.en: And why had you not told me before, doña?
options.feedback: Ask her. The answer is the real lesson, and it is not about bread.
Warm and it ends there. There was one more thing she was ready to tell you.

options.en: You should have told me before.
options.feedback: She did you a kindness. Turning it into a complaint against her is a poor way to receive it.

steps.speaker: Doña Carmen
steps.es: Porque usted era visita. A la visita no se le corrige.
steps.en: Because you were a guest. You do not correct a guest.

options.en: So I am not a guest any more.
options.feedback: That is what she just told you. Being corrected is the promotion, and she waited a year to give it to you.
You have the rule. The thing she was actually saying about you went past.

options.es: Yo prefiero que me corrijan siempre.
options.en: I would rather always be corrected.
options.feedback: That is not on offer. Correction here is a sign of where you stand, not a service you can request.
